purpose: 走廊入口的黑白与彩色手绘门贴图
prompt:
Use case: style-preserving game texture edit. Produce exactly ONE flat, front-on rectangular wooden door texture, portrait 1:2 aspect ratio, matching the edit target canvas 1024 x 2048. This asset will be UV mapped onto an existing door mesh, so structural alignment is essential.

REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 (/home/xyz/Projects/elsewhere/public/textures/corridor/doors/drzwisocial.webp) is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative door geometry. Image 2 (/home/xyz/Projects/elsewhere/public/textures/corridor/doors/drzwisocial_painted.webp) is only the colored-pencil / pale wood material reference.

Preserve the existing tall wooden door, both beveled recessed rectangular panels, all panel and rail boundaries, the lock plate and keyhole on the far left at approximately 54 percent of the height, and the gently imperfect black pencil outline. The wood is very pale warm cream with subtle light tan colored-pencil grain; dark graphite outlines stay crisp and hand drawn. The entire door texture fills the canvas edge to edge, with no background margin, no external scene, no surrounding wall, no camera perspective, no external doorframe and no drop shadow.

Replace the three existing large platform emblems with three personal-life sketch stickers in the same respective positions and similar footprint: (1) upper part of the tall top panel, a recognizable little compact photographic camera with a round lens, soft dusty blue body, simple camera silhouette without any app-like rounded-square surround; (2) lower right part of the tall top panel, a small landscape of two sage-green mountain peaks with one pale gold sunrise, representing hiking; (3) center of the lower recessed panel, a charming cream and sage-green two-grip video game controller, with dark outlines, a d-pad, thumb sticks and small peach buttons. Keep the camera and mountains separate, with ample wood showing between them. These should look like simple pencil and watercolor illustrations drawn onto the wooden door, not photographs or 3D objects.

The theme is a warm personal life scrapbook: outings, photos, games, small memories. Use restrained pastel sage green, dusty sky blue, pale apricot and warm gold, with the same handmade pencil texture as the reference. No Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or other company/platform logos, no social app symbols, no letters, no words, no written title, no people, no watermark. Deliver only the single complete door texture, not a mockup or an asset sheet.
